name: kite-accounting
description: Kite — open-source India-first accounting app (Tauri 2 + React + Rust). Covers companies, ledgers, vouchers, GST, e-invoice, e-way bill, inventory, AI quick entry, reports, Tally migration, bank import, and Kite Enterprise server.
prompt:
You are Kilo, working on the Kite accounting codebase. This is an MIT-licensed, India-first open-source accounting app for small businesses.

## Architecture
- **Frontend**: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 7, react-router-dom v7
- **Desktop**: Tauri 2 (Rust) shell for Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Server**: Kite Enterprise — separate Rust (Axum) server for multi-user browser/PWA mode
- **Database**: SQLite via @tauri-apps/plugin-sql (desktop) or sql.js (browser PWA)
- **Runtime modes**: `tauri` (desktop local SQLite), `remote` (browser + kite-server), `browser` (serverless PWA + IndexedDB)

## Key Directories
- `src/` — React frontend
- `src-tauri/` — Tauri Rust backend (lib.rs, einvoice.rs, ewaybill.rs)
- `kite-server/` — Kite Enterprise Axum server
- `scripts/` — Dev/build/server scripts
- `docs/` — Getting started, migration, AI, deployment guides
- `demo/` — Demo videos and mock data

## Frontend Structure
- `src/App.tsx` — Route definitions (18 pages)
- `src/state/AppContext.tsx` — Global state: companies, auth, permissions
- `src/components/Layout.tsx` — Shell with sidebar navigation
- `src/components/CommandPalette.tsx` — Cmd+K universal command palette
- `src/pages/` — 18 page components
- `src/lib/` — 15 domain modules (accounting, ai, ar, auth, bankimport, dataimport, db, einvoice, ewaybill, gdrive, integrations, inventory, invoice, server, tally)

## Rust Backend (src-tauri/src/lib.rs)
Tauri commands:
- `app_data_dir` — OS app data path
- `send_invoice_email` — SMTP via lettre
- `http_request` — Async HTTP proxy (for AI providers)
- `nic_eway_auth` / `nic_eway_generate` — NIC e-way bill API
- `nic_einv_auth` / `nic_einv_generate` / `nic_einv_cancel` — NIC e-invoice API

Dependencies: tauri 2, tauri-plugin-sql/sqlite, tauri-plugin-fs, tauri-plugin-dialog, tauri-plugin-opener, lettre, reqwest, rsa, aes, ecb, base64

## Kite Server (kite-server/)
Axum server with routes:
- `/api/companies` — list/create
- `/api/companies/{id}` — info
- `/api/companies/{id}/login` — auth
- `/api/companies/{id}/gst` — GST settings
- `/api/companies/{id}/backup` — download SQLite
- `/api/company/query` — read-only SQL
- `/api/company/execute` — write SQL
- `/api/company/ai/chat` — AI proxy (holds API keys)

## Database Schema
Registry: `companies` table (id, name, slug, fy_start, currency, state_code, gstin, gst_enabled, db_file)
Company DB: `meta`, `account_group`, `ledger`, `voucher_type`, `voucher`, `voucher_line`, `unit`, `godown`, `stock_item`, `stock_movement`, `app_user`, `audit_log`, `integration_sync_log`

## Core Features
1. **Companies** — create/open/switch, GST settings, backup (local/Drive/remote)
2. **Ledgers** — chart of accounts, parties (debtors/creditors) with GSTIN/state/contact
3. **Vouchers** — double-entry (sales, purchase, payment, receipt, contra, journal, stock journal) with GST breakdown
4. **GST** — CGST/SGST/IGST, GSTR-1/GSTR-3B reports, Excel export
5. **Inventory** — stock items, godowns, stock movements, opening balances, low-stock alerts
6. **E-Invoice** — NIC IRP API (RSA/AES), generate/cancel IRN, signed QR on PDF
7. **E-Way Bill** — NIC e-way API, generate bills
8. **Bank Import** — CSV/Excel statement → vouchers, AI matching
9. **Data Import** — Excel/CSV master data (ledgers, stock, opening balances)
10. **Tally Migration** — live HTTP pull from Tally Prime (port 9000)
11. **AI Quick Entry** — natural language → voucher draft, bill photo → purchase voucher (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/OpenRouter)
12. **Ask My Books** — natural language Q&A over data (safe SELECT-only SQL generation)
13. **Follow-up** — receivables aging, payment reminders
14. **Period Close** — month-end checklist
15. **Anomalies** — duplicate/unusual voucher detection
16. **Reports** — trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, day book, ledger statement, stock summary
17. **Integrations** — Shopify, WooCommerce sync
18. **Invoice** — PDF download, print, email with SMTP, QR code
19. **Users & Permissions** — Owner/Accountant/Data Entry roles
20. **PWA** — offline-capable with service worker

## Permissions
`manage_users`, `manage_company`, `manage_ledgers`, `manage_inventory`, `create_voucher`, `view_reports`, `view_audit`

## Coding Conventions
- TypeScript strict mode, no unused locals/params
- React functional components with hooks
- All DB access goes through `src/lib/db/client.ts` (supports all 3 runtime modes)
- `getActiveCompanyDb()` returns the current company's Database
- Use `useApp()` hook for global state
- Rust commands are async where they call external APIs
- Tests use Vitest (`*.test.ts`)
- CSS uses CSS modules with BEM-like classes (`.btn`, `.panel`, `.table`, etc.)

## Runtime Mode Detection
- `isTauriRuntime()` — desktop app
- `isRemoteMode()` — browser + kite-server
- `isBrowserMode()` — serverless PWA
All DB modules transparently route through `remote.ts` in remote/browser modes.

## Build
- Dev: `npm run kite:dev` or `npm run tauri dev`
- Build: `npm run kite:build` (nice/ionice, capped Node heap)
- Test: `npm run test` (Vitest)
- Server: `npm run kite:server` (kite-server)
- Installers: `npm run kite:build` produces deb, rpm, msi, nsis, dmg, app

## Key Notes
- e-invoice RSA/AES is only available in Tauri runtime (desktop app)
- AI API keys stored per-company in meta (local) or server (remote)
- `voucher` table has 28+ columns including e-way/IRN fields
- Schema uses `COMPANY_COLUMN_MIGRATIONS` for backward compat
- `src/lib/ai/askSql.ts` enforces read-only SELECT with allowlisted tables
- Google Drive backup is browser-mode only with debounced autosync
